hero.subtitle: GPU-as-a-Service for universities and research with no upfront investment, plus governed AI agents on the same platform.

context.title: Where we play
context.body: For education and research, Sovereign AI is the primary fit; Cybersecurity, Intelligent Operations and Blockchain are relevant; IoT & Edge is a limited fit. The typical first engagement is GPUaaS for research, or AI agents.

challenges.title: GPU capacity without upfront investment
challenges.body: Universities and research are a destination for GPUaaS / AIaaS: on-demand, in-country GPU capacity with no upfront investment.

challenges.title: Arabic-capable models
challenges.body: Private open-weight, Arabic-capable LLMs, with RAG, fine-tuning and guardrails.

challenges.title: Certificates that can be verified
challenges.body: Tamper-proof certificates and records, verifiable in seconds by any authorized party.

useCases.title: GPUaaS for research
useCases.body: In-country GPU capacity and AI services consumed by the hour, on an operator's GPU cloud.

useCases.title: AI agents
useCases.body: Governed AI agents on one platform, with shared data, memory and guardrails.

useCases.title: Trusted digital records
useCases.body: Tamper-proof registries, certificates and contracts on a permissioned ledger hosted in-Kingdom.

vision2030.body: In-country GPU capacity and hosted models for universities and research, with data and AI kept in-Kingdom.
